source_policy: Documented fixed upstream issues only; claims derived from Bugzilla descriptions and reviewed commit messages.

cases.title: [WebContent] Fix Integer Underflow in xmlReadMemory
cases.component: WebCore XML/XSLT and platform-specific encrypted media
cases.root_cause: Potential loss of range information when size values enter libxml2 APIs accepting signed-int lengths.
cases.documented_fix: Explicit INT_MAX precondition checks at three integration points before passing length arguments to libxml2.
cases.scope_caveat: One changed PlayReady initialization data path is GStreamer-specific; no iOS 27.2 binary or version mapping has been verified.

cases.title: Catch integer overflow on 32-bits in JSWebAssemblyArray.h
cases.root_cause: Array count multiplied by element size can wrap when size_t is 32 bits.
cases.documented_fix: Detect and propagate overflow instead of allowing a wrapped allocation-size calculation on 32-bit builds.
cases.scope_caveat: The documented failure condition is explicitly 32-bit size_t; do not assume relevance to an A13 64-bit iPhone build.

cases.title: feConvolveMatrix order causes integer overflow
cases.root_cause: The dimensions used to validate an SVG convolution kernel could produce an overflowing integer product.
cases.documented_fix: Use IntSize::unclampedArea() to avoid overflowing the dimension-product check, per upstream commit message.
cases.scope_caveat: Upstream report describes an assertion/crash in a debug build, not code execution or proven exploitability.

cases.title: IndexedDB string key length integer overflow bypasses bounds check
cases.root_cause: A size-check expression multiplied a uint32_t key length by an element width using arithmetic that could wrap, weakening its intended comparison.
cases.documented_fix: Change the length validation so the bounds check cannot overflow (exact expression should be read from upstream diff before claiming a particular cast).
cases.scope_caveat: Bug report discusses resource exhaustion on a WebKit nightly build; no iOS 27.2 behavior or jailbreak implication established.

comparison_notes: 304140 and 289523 focus on preserving representable size values at interface or allocation boundaries.
308713 and 297624 show why a bound-check computation itself must not overflow before it can reject an input.
These are four different upstream fixes, not four independently demonstrated exploitable security vulnerabilities.
Bugzilla 'RESOLVED FIXED' and mainline changes do not prove Apple iOS 27.2 shipped a vulnerable version or was affected.
289523 is explicitly a 32-bit size_t condition, so no direct inference for the 64-bit A13 device.
